exact_source_clauses.clause: Preferred-path readiness is entered only through `if(pr&&pr->resident)`.
exact_source_clauses.consequence: A direct primitive with execution_available=true but resident=false cannot enter preferred reuse.

exact_source_clauses.clause: If preferred is not treated as resident, policy falls through to acquisition-path scanning.
exact_source_clauses.consequence: I002 has no evidence-backed acquisition path, so an evidence-faithful bundle has no candidate.

exact_source_clauses.clause: With a validated fallback and no acquisition candidate, policy routes fallback.
exact_source_clauses.consequence: I002 direct-ready state is incorrectly routed to baseline.

invalid_workarounds: Set resident=true for a no-residency direct primitive.
Invent an acquisition path absent from I002 evidence.
Make the preferred primitive its own fallback and lose validated baseline fallback semantics.
